topic: stop a toilet tank from sweating and dripping onto the floor
core_question: How do you stop condensation on a toilet tank from dripping onto the floor?
answer_summary: Install a foam insulation liner inside the tank (or a mixing/anti-sweat valve on the supply line) so the tank's outer surface stays closer to room temperature and stops condensing.
persona: impatient and curt; texting quickly with typos here and there
